title: A2S agent output (a2-special-transcriber)
description: Section 9/A2S and the a2-special-transcriber agent file (Appendix B): table -> header/rows/repeated_header; figure -> caption/labels; equation -> latex/number; box -> text (+ optional latex/number). `box` is a fourth kind added 2026-10-13: SPEC 9/A2S names only the first three, but A2's own kind enum includes `box` and A2 agents do mark boxes needs_special when a worked example's display equations would be lost. Six such blocks exist in the real corpus (CHE12L ch1 p005/p008/p016, ch9 p005/p006, PHY11L ch6 p017) and FOUR of them carry text:"" -- so the prose was never captured anywhere and the box is unquotable. Five separate A2S workers hit these and each improvised a different shape (two relabelled them `equation`, three kept `box` and invented a `text` field), which is why the kind is now defined rather than left to chance.

header.description: Table only: the header row, cells copied exactly.

rows.description: Table only: data rows, cells copied exactly, consistent column count per the A2S check.

repeated_header.description: Table only: true if this table continues from the previous page and its header row repeats.

caption.description: Figure only: copied exactly, e.g. 'Figure 10.2 ...'. Non-empty per the A2S check.

labels.description: Figure only: every label word/line on the figure, top-left to bottom-right. No description of the drawing.

latex.description: Equation only: copied exactly as printed. Must parse per the A2S check.

number.description: Equation only: the printed equation number, e.g. '(3.16)', or null if unnumbered. Box: the box's printed label, e.g. 'Example 1.4'.

text.description: Box only: the box's prose copied exactly as printed. This is the field that makes the box quotable -- quote_verify.find matches a citation word-for-word against passage text, so a box with no text can never be cited.
